headlines.title: Market sell-off gains steam as concerns about Iran war and high AI spending collide
headlines.description: U.S. equity markets sold off sharply as fears that Israel and the U.S. would attack Iran sent oil prices higher, while stocks failed to hold onto recent gains.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer ask guests to clean dishes or make beds
headlines.description: Airbnb hosts can only set “reasonable” housecleaning duties for guests, according to new guidelines rolled out by the tech giant, with tasks such as dishwashing and bed stripping now the sole responsibility of homeowners.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs spends big to give small businesses an AI boost
headlines.description: The Wall Street giant is committing $500 million to expand its 10,000 Small Businesses program and launch an AI institute, partnering with Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic to bring AI know-how to Main Street. NBC's Christine Romans spoke exclusively with Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon and with small businesses figuring out how to make AI work for them.

headlines.title: Using AI to clone and bank people's voices who are losing them because of diseases like ALS
headlines.description: After ALS took her ability to speak, Monica O'Callaghan turned to AI voice cloning technology to preserve her voice. The breakthrough helped her deliver an emotional wedding speech in her own voice and reclaim part of her identity.

headlines.title: New Mexico awarded $25 billion civil penalty against Meta
headlines.description: A judge has ordered Meta to pay the state of New Mexico a civil penalty of $25 billion after a jury found the company misled users about the privacy of their data. NBC News' Allie Canal has details on the ruling.

headlines.title: iPhone Duo review: Is Apple's first foldable smartphone too expensive?
headlines.description: Apple will release the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, this Friday. NBC News' chief technology analyst Joanna Stern reviews the new iPhone and its hefty price tag.

headlines.title: How to Score Tickets to Shop TODAY’s Immersive Holiday House
headlines.description: Shop TODAY is hosting their first-ever Holiday House event on three floors of a historic mansion in New York City on Nov. 19. The immersive experience will feature a signature brand bazaar filled with interactive activations and giveaways, a photo-op with Santa as well as special guests like Amanda Seyfried, the Broadway cast of “Chicago,” and “Real Housewives of New Jersey” star Melissa Gorga!

headlines.title: Kids are spending more time on YouTube at school
headlines.description: Children are spending more time watching non-educational videos on YouTube during school, according to an NBC News investigation. NBC News' Tyler Kingkade has more on what he found.

headlines.title: AI and the cognitive confidence trap
headlines.description: Can AI make us feel smarter than we really are? Princeton psychologist Dr. Tania Lombrozo explains the Dunning-Kruger effect, the illusion of understanding, and how AI shapes our perception of expertise, explaining why confidence doesn't always mean we truly understand what we know.

headlines.title: Tesla unveils new flying car model
headlines.description: It may be a giant leap forward in making flying cars a reality, or a fantastic publicity stunt. Elon Musk is showing off a new Tesla Roadster that can fly. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Tesla unveils its next generation 'flying' Roadster
headlines.description: Tesla has unveiled a new generation of the Roadster that Elon Musk believes will be able to fly. The sports car has new features such as air jets that allow the car to perform brief mid-air maneuvers. Musk says the car is set to start production in 2028. NBC News' Brian Cheung has more on the advancing technology.

headlines.title: Tesla shows its long-delayed Roadster that can briefly fly through the air
headlines.description: Tesla showed off a new version of its long-delayed Roadster, demonstrating a prototype sports car that can briefly fly through the air using high-pressure gas thrusters developed with SpaceX.
